output.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND LOWER(c.segment) = 'enterprise'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
output.explanation: This query adds up net revenue by country for enterprise customers' orders placed in 2025, sorted from highest to lowest. It only counts orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue = true), so cancelled or other non-revenue orders are left out. The segment match ignores upper and lower case because I couldn't check how 'enterprise' is spelled in the data. Each country's total is rounded to 2 decimals.
